卡片里有什么What's in the card

进入任意代币页，卡片自动弹出（可关）。顶部三个标签，是同一个问题的三个层次： 这币讲的什么故事，社区拿什么理由持仓，掏钱的都是谁。Open any token page and the card pops up (can be turned off). Three tabs, three layers of the same question: what story this token tells, why the community is holding, and who actually put money in.

MetaThesisHolders

Meta — 这币是什么Meta — what this token is

DeBot 的叙事分析全量呈现：起源与评级理由默认摊开，来源推文 / 传播 / 开发者收成一行标题点开看。第一屏先给结论，不是先给篇幅。占位套话（"暂无"、"未发现"之类）自动过滤，不占卡片高度。币名右侧的小蓝 chips 是这只币的副池交易对（如 $HIMS $LLY $NVDA）——ETH / 稳定币这类谁都有的主池不占位，只显示有信息量的非常规配对，悬停看各池流动性。DeBot's full narrative analysis: origin and rating rationale open by default; source tweets / spread / developer notes collapse to one line each. Conclusions first, length later. Placeholder filler ("N/A", "none found"…) is filtered out. The small blue chips next to the ticker are this token's secondary-pool pairs (e.g. $HIMS $LLY $NVDA) — ETH / stablecoin main pools that every token has are hidden on purpose; only the unusual pairings show, hover for per-pool liquidity.

MetaThesisHolders

Thesis — 持有人自己怎么说Thesis — in the holders' own words

从 Fomo Holders 表读取这只币的观点，按点赞展示前 30 条，保留 Fomo 总数与截断提示。每条带持仓和盈亏；评论流可读时可切「最新 ≥2赞」。原文保留，本地翻译取决于浏览器支持。Read this token’s theses from Fomo, show the top 30 by likes, and preserve the reported total and truncation notice. Rows include position and PnL; switch to newest ≥2 likes when the feed is readable. Originals are retained; local translation depends on browser support.

MetaThesisHolders

Holders — 掏钱的都是谁Holders — who actually put money in

展示已读取仓位中最大的 6 位：仓位、盈亏、持有时长，悬停看平均买入价。新增 Fomo 持仓横栏，按全部已读持仓金额 ÷ 市值计算；未读全标 ≥，同时列出已读人数 / 总人数。Show the six largest loaded positions with PnL and holding duration; hover for average entry. The new Fomo share bar divides all loaded holdings by market cap. Incomplete coverage shows ≥ and loaded/total holder counts.

悬停预览 — 不用点进去Hover preview — no click needed

在代币行上停留约 0.6 秒即可预览，📌 可固定。支持 Fomo 列表、GMGN 代币行，以及 XXYY 新旧界面的收藏与钱包监控。换币、筛选和虚拟行更新时重新识别实际 CA。Hover for about 0.6 seconds to preview; 📌 pins the card. Works with Fomo lists, GMGN token rows, and favorites/monitor widgets in both XXYY layouts. Token identity is checked again as rows and filters change.

一切可调Everything adjustable

设置支持中文 / English，可调自动弹出、悬停、亮度、透明度及更新检查。布局按站点保存。扩展无需单独账号；Thesis、Holders 和持仓占比需要 Fomo 登录。Chinese / English settings cover automatic opening, hover, brightness, opacity and update checks. Layouts are saved per site. No separate extension account; Thesis, Holders and share require Fomo login.

Fomo 数据怎样取得How Fomo data is read

使用现有 Fomo 登录，只读代币页面。Use your existing Fomo login to read token pages.

在 Fomo 读取当前页。在 GMGN / XXYY 优先读取已打开的同币 Fomo 页；没有可读页面时，打开不激活的临时页，读完关闭。已有页面不会被点击、滚动或跳转。On Fomo, read the current page. On GMGN / XXYY, reuse an open matching Fomo page or open an inactive temporary page and close it after reading. Existing Fomo pages are not clicked, scrolled or navigated.

临时页会正常向 Fomo 加载数据。扩展不提取 cookie、登录令牌、私钥或助记词，不下单，没有开发者自建采集服务器或遥测。Temporary pages load data normally from Fomo. The extension does not extract cookies, login tokens, private keys or seed phrases, or place trades. It has no developer-operated collection server or telemetry.

来源Source用途Purpose

Preferences use browser storage; Chrome may sync some settings. Switching card tabs does not stop the other data requests. 完整隐私说明Full privacy policy

装上它Install

不经过应用商店，直接加载源目录，一分钟。Chrome / Edge / Brave 通用（Safari、Firefox 内核不同，不支持）。No web store — load the folder directly, one minute. Works on Chrome / Edge / Brave (Safari and Firefox use different engines and are not supported).

  1. 下载并解压Download and unzip

    点上方「下载最新版 zip」。双击 zip 自动解压出 fomo-helper 文件夹。在 zip 上右键 →「全部解压缩…」解压出 fomo-helper 文件夹。不要双击进入 zip 直接用——那是个预览视图，Chrome 读不到它。Click “Download latest zip” above. Double-click the zip to get a fomo-helper folder.Right-click the zip → “Extract All…” to get a fomo-helper folder. Don't just double-click into the zip — that is a preview view Chrome cannot read.

  2. 把文件夹放到一个固定位置Put the folder somewhere permanent

    建议从「下载」挪到固定目录，比如 ~/Documents/Extensions/。 建议从「下载」挪到固定目录，比如 C:\Extensions\。 浏览器每次启动都从这个文件夹读取扩展——放在下载目录里，哪天清理下载就把扩展清没了。Move it out of Downloads to a fixed place such as ~/Documents/Extensions/. Move it out of Downloads to a fixed place such as C:\Extensions\. The browser loads the extension from this folder on every start — leave it in Downloads and one cleanup wipes the extension.

  3. 打开扩展页，开启开发者模式Open the extensions page, enable Developer mode

    地址栏输入 chrome://extensions（Edge 用 edge://extensions）， 打开右上角的「开发者模式」开关。Type chrome://extensions in the address bar (edge://extensions on Edge) and flip the “Developer mode” switch top-right.

  4. 加载已解压的扩展程序Load unpacked

    点「加载已解压的扩展程序」，选中刚才那个含 manifest.json 的文件夹。工具栏出现图标即安装成功。Click “Load unpacked” and pick the folder containing manifest.json. When the icon appears in the toolbar, you're done.

  5. 登录 Fomo，打开三站代币页Sign in to Fomo, then open a token page

    在同一浏览器配置中登录 fomo.family，再打开 Fomo、GMGN 或 XXYY 的代币页。停用旧的独立版本，避免重复弹框；首次升级后刷新已打开的网页。Sign in at fomo.family in the same browser profile, then open a Fomo, GMGN or XXYY token page. Disable older separate editions to avoid duplicate cards; refresh existing website tabs once after upgrading.

更新方式：下载新版 zip，解压覆盖原来的文件夹，回 chrome://extensions 点该扩展卡片上的刷新圈 ↻（或重启浏览器）。配置不会丢——扩展 ID 是固定的， 即使你把文件夹挪去别的位置重装，名单和设置也都在原地。想收到新版本提醒，在 GitHub 上 Watch → Custom → Releases 即可。Updating: download the new zip, unzip over the same folder, go back to chrome://extensions and hit ↻ on the extension card (or restart the browser). Settings survive — the extension ID is fixed, so even moving the folder and reinstalling keeps everything. For release notifications, Watch → Custom → Releases on GitHub.

常见问题Questions

装好了，但没有卡片Installed, but no card
检查扩展已启用并可访问当前站点，刷新网页。曾关闭自动弹出的设置会保留，可点小放大镜或到设置开启。Check that the extension is enabled and allowed on this site, then refresh. If automatic opening was disabled, use the magnifier or enable it in settings.
Thesis / Holders 读不到Thesis / Holders cannot be read
打开卡片给出的 Fomo 链接，确认同一浏览器已登录，等代币内容出现后返回点 ↻。筛选和懒加载会限制可读行数，注意覆盖人数；读取失败不代表零持仓。Open the supplied Fomo link, check login in the same browser profile, wait for the token data and press ↻. Filters and lazy loading limit coverage; a read failure is not zero holdings.
当前页叙事暂不可用Current narrative unavailable
v0.9.21 修复了 XXYY 默认页 CA 大小写和池子解析问题。短暂故障自动补试一次；持续失败可手动重试。DeBot 没有收录或暂不可用时，Fomo 数据仍独立读取。v0.9.21 fixes XXYY current-page address case and pool resolution. Transient failures retry once; persistent failures allow manual Retry. DeBot coverage/outages are independent of Fomo data.
持仓占比为什么有 ≥Why does share show ≥?
占比按已读取的 Fomo 持仓金额合计除以页面市值计算；没读全时是下界，不是完整链上持仓统计。Share is loaded Fomo position value divided by page market cap. Partial coverage gives a lower bound, not complete on-chain ownership.
整页翻译后读取异常Page translation affects reading
优先使用站内语言设置，或让浏览器显示原文。卡片自己的本地翻译是另一项功能，依赖浏览器支持。Prefer the site’s language setting or show the original page. The card’s local translation is a separate browser-dependent feature.
站点改版或私有监控列表Site changes and private monitor lists
上游改版可能影响解析。GMGN 私有钱包监控做了安装态模拟验证；真实验收覆盖公开代币页，尚未覆盖真人登录后的私有监控列表。Upstream changes may affect parsing. GMGN private monitor lists have installed-fixture coverage; live acceptance covered its public token page, not a signed-in private list.
